items.label: U.S. House
items.text: U.S. Representative since January 3, 2017; elected in 2016 in the 20th District and represented the 20th District from 2017 to 2023; represents the 19th District since redistricting. (sources: Wikipedia https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jimmy_Panetta [search summary, secondary]; Office of Rep. Jimmy Panetta (house.gov) https://panetta.house.gov/sites/evo-subsites/panetta.house.gov/files/documents/2023%20Congressman%20Jimmy%20Panetta%20Biography.pdf [search summary, primary])

items.label: Prosecutor
items.text: Prosecutor in Alameda County and Monterey County; Vote Smart lists Alameda County, 1996 to 2010, and Monterey County, 2010 to 2016. (sources: Office of Rep. Jimmy Panetta (house.gov) https://panetta.house.gov/sites/evo-subsites/panetta.house.gov/files/documents/2023%20Congressman%20Jimmy%20Panetta%20Biography.pdf [search summary, primary]; Vote Smart https://justfacts.votesmart.org/candidate/biography/169078/ [search summary, secondary])

items.label: Military service
items.text: Officer in the U.S. Navy Reserve; deployed to Afghanistan (one profile gives service dates of 2007 to 2009). (sources: VoteVets https://votevets.org/candidates/congressman-jimmy-panetta [search summary, secondary]; Wikipedia https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jimmy_Panetta [search summary, secondary])

items.label: Education
items.text: Attended Monterey Peninsula College; undergraduate degree in international relations, University of California, Davis; J.D., Santa Clara University, 1996. (sources: Office of Rep. Jimmy Panetta (house.gov) https://panetta.house.gov/sites/evo-subsites/panetta.house.gov/files/documents/2023%20Congressman%20Jimmy%20Panetta%20Biography.pdf [search summary, primary]; Jimmy Panetta campaign https://www.jimmypanetta.com/meet-jimmy [search summary, primary]; Santa Clara Magazine https://magazine.scu.edu/classnote/jimmy-panetta/ [search summary, secondary])
